A lush forest filled with plentiful food and resources. Many elves and dryads call this forest home. The trees tower over the landscape, hiding the homes of the elves that live there. 

To the east lies a small elven outpost named Teldorill after the great tree which sits at its center. 

In the south-east houses the orcish outpost of Gromaul. 

A river runs through to the south called Archer's Bend. Beware the Snaproc that call the river home as they are quite territorial.
